hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Transform Manhattan distance into maximum difference along rotated axes u = x + y and v = x - y.

hints.title: Candidate Reductions
hints.text: The pair of points with maximum distance must involve the minimum or maximum points in either the u or v dimension.

hints.title: Pruning Evaluation
hints.text: Identify the at most four unique candidate points achieving these extrema. Evaluate maximum distance omitting each candidate and return the minimum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing at most four candidate exclusions in linear time each.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible single point removals takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary arrays for rotated coordinates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply the standard Manhattan coordinate rotation identity |x1 - x2| + |y1 - y2| = max(|u1 - u2|, |v1 - v2|).
